purpose: Attribute the direction-dependent BC2-B0/B2 response error to the fixed-to-moving interface closure versus the water-table boundary closure without propagating a reduced state or fitting a new closure.

prior_exposure.observed: B2 improves WT_HOLD and WT_RISE storage/cumulative exchange relative to B0, but worsens WT_FALL and WT_CYCLE.
prior_exposure.firewall: This observation motivates face-level attribution only. No operator coefficient, sign-dependent switch, blending law or new closure is authorized or fitted.

reference_projection.geometry: same 0-90 cm 9x10cm fixed layers plus moving 90..H(t) layer as BC2-B0/B1/B2
reference_projection.state_at_each_accepted_time: exact fixed-cell Reference storages and exact moving unsaturated Reference storage from A2
reference_projection.H: strict interior zero-pressure crossing from A2
reference_projection.q90_identity_role: derived exactly from the conservative moving-layer balance; must independently close against the A2 moving-storage ledger.

PATH_PRESERVING_B1.q90: B2 residual-only q90 + exact equilibrium-path q90_E(H,Hdot)
PATH_PRESERVING_B1.qH: B2 residual-only qH + exact equilibrium-path qH_E(H,Hdot)

time_alignment.primary: For each Reference observation interval, evaluate each candidate operator at the accepted start and end projected Reference states and compare the trapezoidal average to the interval-average Reference flux.
time_alignment.endpoint_diagnostic: Also report end-state instantaneous candidate values, but do not use them for face attribution because Reference authority is interval-integrated exchange.
time_alignment.no_hidden_reference_state: Only A2 accepted state endpoints and exact moving-storage balance are used.

metrics_per_face_operator_stratum: Pearson correlation where variance is nonzero
joint_metrics: RMS q90 error divided by RMS qH error, reported only when denominator nonzero
signed error covariance between q90 and qH
direction-conditioned ranking of STANDARD_B0, RESIDUAL_ONLY_B2 and PATH_PRESERVING_B1 for q90, qH and moving-layer tendency

adjudication.supported_statement_rule: A face may be called consistently larger-error only when both RMS and mean-absolute error are greater for that face in every nonempty moving direction stratum for the same operator.
adjudication.direction_dependence_rule: A correction is direction dependent when its component-wise ordering relative to STANDARD_B0 changes between WATER_TABLE_RISING and WATER_TABLE_FALLING on either q90 or qH.
